description: Read the agent's audit log entries (90-day retention). Filter by event_type (comma-separated), since/before timestamps. Useful for reviewing key rotations, market creations, rate limit hits, and webhook events.

before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — events before this time.

event_type.description: Comma-separated event types: key_created, market_created, rate_limit_hit, auth_failed, webhook_created, etc.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — events after this time.

name: get_audit_log
